rule: S1 convergence: >=5 FRESH accounts (in-window create_account 201) whose FIRST gated action is the SAME gated repo, created within W=600s. S4 single-purpose: account touches exactly 1 gated repo, <=2 distinct non-gated endpoints, short life, silent after pulling. PAGE = a convergence cohort that is >=50% single-purpose. Origin-independent AND partition-independent. UA/timing excluded (harness artefacts).
note: Not pre-registered; out-of-sample check on the same held-out seeds used for H7. Covers G2 (overlap-to-evade) because it does not depend on shard disjointness.
limits: Window-bound: spreading account creation beyond 600s breaks S1 convergence (shared with H7).
Single-purpose is attacker-controllable: a swarm can add decoy browsing to raise per-account endpoint/lifetime diversity (costs model calls/volume).
Shares the fresh-account assumption; a standing-account swarm evades -> identity-friction argument.
